mapper.select: SELECT id, public_no, status, open_at, close_at, deleted_at FROM market_question WHERE public_no = #{publicNo}
mapper.sql: r.id, r.user_id, r.market_id, r.status, r.token, r.created_at, r.sent_at, m.public_no, m.title_en, m.title_zh_cn, m.title_zh_tw, m.status AS market_status, m.open_at, m.close_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM market_reminder r JOIN market_question m ON m.id = r.market_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.market_id = #{marketId}
SELECT FROM market_reminder r JOIN market_question m ON m.id = r.market_id WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM market_reminder r JOIN market_question m ON m.id = r.market_id WHERE r.token = #{token}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO market_reminder (user_id, market_id, status, token, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{marketId}, 'ACTIVE', #{token}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_reminder WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

(SELECT FROM market_reminder r JOIN market_question m ON m.id = r.market_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE') UNION ALL (SELECT FROM market_reminder r JOIN market_question m ON m.id = r.market_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status != 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}) ORDER BY open_at, id
